name: videospace
description: Fullscreen YouTube videos open in their own macOS Space, and the tab slides back into its window when you exit.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && rm -f videospace-$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist && zip -qrX ../videospace-$npm_package_version.zip . && cd .. && echo "Created videospace-$npm_package_version.zip"
